🍖 FEAST 📺 — Sanjay opens the pantry wide: 8× Foraged food. Elijah, Liam eat until the fire burns low. Somebody laughs so hard they cry. For one evening, nobody is surviving — they're just together. (−1,600 kcal from the pantry) The channeled keepsake feeds the feast — the feast was the weapon, and the surge rides the fire until tomorrow's dawn, spent only when the blades are warmed. (FEAST SURGE

🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Night Court is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

Owl. Tastes like chicken that judged you first. It's dead. The carcass is there on the ground — search the body if you want the meat. But you don't know this flesh. Clean it, test it cautiously, or ask someone who knows. And don't leave it long: meat rots where it lies.
